facts.fact: UK FCDO reports an active project, started 2024-11-08 and funded at GBP 43,000, in which the UK ONS supports Rwanda's national statistics institute NISR to bring Earth Observation techniques and machine learning into agricultural statistics.
facts.system: Partnership Fund: Using EO technology to improve production of agriculture statistics in Rwanda

systems.system: Partnership Fund EO agricultural statistics project

RWA.note: Machine learning for agricultural statistics is not an AI system in service in administration.
Machine learning is mentioned only as a planned technique for statistics; no AI tool in a sector system is stated.
No AI model, dataset or computing built in Rwanda is stated.
